added: Merging tags, authors or sources now rewrites every saved search that names a merged-away one to name the survivor, in the merge's own transaction (SavedSearchRepository.moveReferences, called from ReferenceEditRepository.merge). A saved search this build cannot read is left untouched, and Undo puts a rewritten search back only while nothing has changed it since. SyncLocalRepository.aliasMaps reads every alias in one query for the saved-search resolver, which reads a search that still names a merged-away id as the survivor while the alias exists.
